title: catapodium tenellum var. aristatum
intro: Catapodium tenellum var. aristatum, commonly known as aristate wood grass, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and treat various gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Catapodium tenellum var. aristatum include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and act as a hepatoprotective agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
